productFit.name: Peak Design Travel Tripod (Aluminum)
productFit.metricSpecs: 14 cm minimum working height, 152,4 cm maximum working height, 39,1 cm packed length, 9,1 kg load (Foto Koch listing, maker article 59202040)
productFit.reason: Sold in Germany under the same name by Foto Koch; Peak Design sells it worldwide from its own shop.

productFit.name: Manfrotto Befree Advanced Aluminum Travel Tripod (Lever, Ball Head)
productFit.variant: MKBFRLA4BK-BH (EU/CA code) instead of the US MKBFRLA4BK-BHUS; same Befree Advanced lever aluminium kit with ball head
productFit.metricSpecs: 1,59 kg with head, 128 cm with the column down, 151 cm column up, 40 cm folded (Manfrotto); the German retailer Foto Erhardt lists an 8 kg max load for the -BH kit versus 9 kg safety payload on the Manfrotto US page
productFit.reason: The English post links the -BHUS page; in Europe the same kit is sold as MKBFRLA4BK-BH (Foto Erhardt, Manfrotto CA page uses the same code).

productFit.name: Vanguard Alta Pro 2+ 263AB Gen 2 Aluminum Tripod with Ball Head
productFit.reason: The Gen 2 kit appears on Vanguard USA, B&H and Adorama only. Vanguard Spain lists the earlier Alta Pro 2 263AB 100 (BH-100 head, 140,5 cm without column, 173,7 cm max, 70 cm folded, 2,207 kg, 7 kg load) as discontinued; no EU page for the Gen 2 was found. Not swapped: one neutral sentence in its Who it is for text.

productFit.name: Manfrotto 190XPRO3 Aluminum 3-Section Tripod (MT190XPRO3)
productFit.metricSpecs: 160 cm column up, 135 cm column down, 9 cm minimum, 59 cm folded, 2 kg, 15 kg safety payload (Manfrotto global page, already in the post)
productFit.reason: Manfrotto sells the MT190XPRO3 under the same code on its global site; a long-running EU model.

productFit.name: Feisol CT-3472 Elite Rapid 4-Section Carbon Fiber Tripod
productFit.metricSpecs: Feisol Europe lists the CT-3472 M2 Rapid at 1,81 kg and a load of over 30 kg (the post uses 1,78 kg / 30 kg from feisol.net)
productFit.reason: Feisol Europe (feisol.eu) sells the CT-3472 M2 Rapid directly; the maker sells the Mark 2 version, as the English post notes.

localFacts.fact: KLM allows 1 piece of hand baggage of max. 55 x 35 x 25 cm including handles and wheels; small bag and hand baggage together up to 12 kg. The Peak Design (39,4 cm) and the Befree Advanced (40 cm) fold shorter than 55 cm; the MT190XPRO3 (59 cm) and the Vanguard (about 72 cm) do not.
Nationaal Park Zuid-Kennemerland: walking is only allowed on the marked roads and paths (except play areas), so a dune tripod spot has to be on or beside the path.
Natuurmonumenten: walking off roads and paths in Zuid-Kennemerland is not allowed because it disturbs animals and damages fragile soil and plants.
Staatsbosbeheer asks visitors to check the access signs and stay on the paths meant for them.

localPainPoints.pain: With the centre column fully up the tripod may not stay still outside in wind.
localPainPoints.fix: Extend the legs first and leave the column down; the Alta Pro reaches 141 cm column down, the Feisol has no column.

quotes.text: Alles staat op zich wel stabiel, het wiebelt niet, maar of het buiten in de wind helemaal stil blijft staan betwijfel ik.

localPainPoints.pain: A tripod that is too short means bending to the viewfinder.
localPainPoints.fix: Compare column-down heights (128-147 cm) and add the head and camera; use a tilting screen on the Peak Design.

quotes.text: 165 cm is gewoon bukken als je door de zoeker wilt kijken, zelfs al ben je niet heel lang.

localPainPoints.pain: Long lenses vibrate in strong wind even on a sturdy tripod.
localPainPoints.fix: For a 100-400 mm or longer pick the MT190XPRO3 or Feisol, lower the tripod and shield it with your body.

quotes.text: zelfs op een stevig statief kunnen ze onder invloed van de wind in een soort trilling raken

localGain.point: Which picks fit KLM hand baggage (55 cm) by folded length.
Dune path rules in Zuid-Kennemerland for tripod spots on the coast.
Metric column-down heights first, answering the Dutch "bukken" complaint.
